# proxmox_node_acme_certificate (Resource)

Orders an ACME certificate for one node through `/nodes/{node}/certificates/acme/certificate` and waits for the order task. The order needs an ACME account, an ACME plugin for the challenge and a node domain that resolves publicly. Every attribute change replaces the instance and orders anew; destroy revokes the certificate. Changing the certificate does not restart pveproxy itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_acme_certificate" "pve1" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  account = proxmox_acme_account.le.name
  domains = ["pve1.example.com"]
  domain_plugins = {
    "pve1.example.com" = proxmox_acme_plugin.cloudflare.plugin
  }

  triggers = { generation = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) ACME account name used for the order. Changes require replacement.
- `domains` (Set of String) Domains to put into the certificate. Must resolve publicly to this node. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node to order a certificate for. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when a new order is due; changing any of them orders again.

### Optional

- `domain_plugins` (Map of String) Optional map of domain to ACME plugin id for the challenge; unmapped domains fall back to the wildcard plugin.
- `force` (Boolean) Overwrite an existing certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Certificate identifier (the node name).
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID of the last order.
